# Results overview {.unnumbered}

This is the cross-protein overview of the **repbc_2026-10-01** analysis: protein phenotypes were Box-Cox normalized on the individual replicates, scanned for pQTL with wisam-weighted miqtl models, and followed up at each significant locus with credible intervals, Merge, TIMBR and RNA mediation. Protein symbols are uppercase; **CES2 is excluded** because of a protein QC issue. Every figure is shown here and can be downloaded with the link beneath it; per-protein results are in the protein chapters.

## Cross-protein summary

One row per protein: normalization λ, the strongest pQTL, significant peaks with their cis/trans type, protein broad-sense H², and the paired transcript with its H². A † marks a transcript measured by a shared multi-gene probe. [Download the table (CSV)](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/integrated_summary.csv){download="integrated_summary.csv"}.

## Significant pQTL

13 genome-wide significant peaks in 10 proteins (plus 1 in the zero-inflated subset scan). A peak is **cis** when the gene encoding the protein lies within its 90% credible interval and **trans** otherwise ([CSV](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/pqtl_cis_trans.csv){download="pqtl_cis_trans.csv"}). Credible intervals, gene tracks and follow-up for each are in the [credible-interval appendix](credible_intervals.qmd) and the protein chapters.

## Heritability and strain structure

![Broad-sense heritability of each protein and its paired transcript (left) and clustered Box-Cox protein profiles across strains (right).](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_profiles_split.png){fig-align="center" width="95%"}

::: {.fig-downloads}
Download: [PNG](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_profiles_split.png){download="figure2_heritability_profiles_split.png"} · [PDF](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_profiles_split.pdf){download="figure2_heritability_profiles_split.pdf"} · [CSV](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_protein_and_transcript.csv){download="figure2_heritability_protein_and_transcript.csv"}
:::

Protein H² is the strain share of replicate variance (random-intercept REML on the Box-Cox replicates) with parametric-bootstrap 95% intervals; transcript H² uses individual-sample RINT values with scan date as a fixed effect. † marks a shared multi-gene probe and — a protein without a defensible transcript pair. Alternative layouts: [single panel (PNG)](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_profiles_blackgreen.png){download="figure2_heritability_profiles_blackgreen.png"} · [combined colours (PNG)](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/figure2_heritability_profiles.png){download="figure2_heritability_profiles.png"}.

### Protein–transcript pairing

![Correlation across CC strains between each protein and its paired transcript (outlined diagonal) and the other paired transcripts.](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/protein_transcript_correlation_heatmap.png){fig-align="center" width="95%"}

::: {.fig-downloads}
Download: [PNG](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/protein_transcript_correlation_heatmap.png){download="protein_transcript_correlation_heatmap.png"} · [PDF](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/protein_transcript_correlation_heatmap.pdf){download="protein_transcript_correlation_heatmap.pdf"}
:::

Proteins were paired to transcripts from the measured peptide, not the protein name ([pairing table (CSV)](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/protein_transcript_pairs.csv){download="protein_transcript_pairs.csv"}). Proteins with no pair (CES1, CYP2C9) are omitted.

![Trait correlations: H² on the diagonal, genetic correlation (squares) below, phenotypic correlation (circles) above.](figures/repbc_2026-10-01/protein_genetic_phenotypic_correlation_heatmap.png){fig-align="center" width="95%"}

## Follow-up coverage

Mediation, TIMBR and Merge were run at every significant locus; what is currently available is itemised in [Analysis progress](status.qmd).
